rows: Hail up to the size of pennies covered the ground at Big Bend Ranch State Park.
Nickel size hail was accompanied by 40 to 50 mph winds, two to four miles west-northwest of Lajitas.
Sheriff's office reported penny sized hail in Marfa.
The Presidio County Sheriff's Office reported that the roof on a brand new mobile home was blown off.
A convenience store employee in Marfa reported penny to quarter sized hail and very strong winds.
Nickel sized hail and a wind gust of 51 mph were reported at the Marfa Aerostat.
Golfball sized hail fell on U.S. Highway 90 for a duration of ten minutes.
Tennis ball sized hail fell along Farm to Market Road 2810.
Marfa Automated Surface Observing System measured a thunderstorm wind gust of 62 mph. No damage was reported.
A 60 mph wind gust was estimated by a storm spotter in Shafter. No damage was reported with this gust.
The time of this report was estimated based on radar data.

A severe thunderstorm developed in Presidio County and produced golfball sized hail in Shafter. The hail resulted in five pickup truck windshields being destroyed and several homes with broken windows. The cost of the damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved over Presidio County and produced penny sized hail nine miles west southwest of Valentine.
A thunderstorm moved over Presidio County and produced nickel to golfball sized hail on FM 2810 seven miles west southwest of Marfa.
A thunderstorm moved over Presidio County and produced pingpong ball sized hail on Pinto Canyon Road eight miles west southwest of Marfa.

A thunderstorm moved across Presidio County and produced 50 to 60 mph wind gusts in Marfa. Four inch diameter tree limbs were knocked down as a result of these winds. The cost of damage is a rough estimate.

A thunderstorm moved across Presidio County and produced tennis ball to baseball sized hail at Big Bend Ranch State Park. The hail broke a sideview mirror on a vehicle and broke a skylight on a camper. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A storm moved across Presidio County and produced a 64 mph wind gust north of Presidio as recorded by the local AWOS site.
A thunderstorm moved across Presidio County and produced a 59 mph wind gust north of the City of Presidio as recorded by the local AWOS.
A thunderstorm moved across Presidio County and produced one inch hail near Ryan at the Aerostat site northwest of Marfa.
A thunderstorm moved across Presidio County and produced a 60 mph wind gust in Marfa.
A thunderstorm moved across Presidio County and produced a 73 mph wind gust one mile east southeast of Marfa.
A thunderstorm moved across Presidio County and produced a 59 mph wind gust five miles north of the town of Presidio.
A thunderstorm moved across Presidio County and produced a 67 mph wind gust at the AWOS site near the town of Presidio.
Quarter to ping pong ball-size hail was reported by a storm chaser near RM 169 and US 67. The time of occurrence is estimated by radar.
The Mesonet site TWB93 Alamito Ranch recorded a 58 mph wind gust. The duration/time of occurrence is partially estimated.
The West Texas Mesonet station 156 Marfa 13SE measured a downburst wind gust of 70 mph.
A maximum wind gust of 58 MPH was measured at the West Texas Mesonet site, 156 Marfa 13 SE.
Presidio County Sheriff's Office relayed a report of quarter-size hail at the Port of Entry in Presidio. The total time of occurrence is partially estimated from radar.
